decision.summary: A sustained multi-axis offset begins at index 570 (N/E up, U down), persisting through the allowed context. A transient opposing behavior in U near 620–624 does not reverse the trend on any axis and lacks a confirmed return; thus the interval remains uncertain. No other temporary offsets are supported by consistent cross-axis evidence within [535,665].

intervals.observation: Sustained monotonic trend in N, E (upward) and U (downward) from index 570 onward; no return observed within allowed context. A brief flattening/rise in U at ~620–624 opposes the dominant trend but does not constitute a full return—N/E continue rising, and U resumes decline after 624. Interior is coherent and persistent; onset clear at 570, but return unobserved before 665.
